mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 4.0%) as of t-1mo signals accommodative monetary policy that compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS < 4.0%, 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of cases over the last 5 years (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%) as of t-1mo indicates aggressive monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of cases over the last 5 years (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.5%) and strong employment growth (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% MoM) signals robust labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: In instances where UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% MoM, 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of cases (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, strong housing starts (HOUST > 1500) and robust GDP growth (GDPC1 growth > 0.5% QoQ) indicate sustained consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions (GDP growth > 0.5% QoQ and unemployment < 4.0%), HOUST > 1500 and GDPC1 growth > 0.5% QoQ, but 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of cases (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 3.5%) as of t-1mo signals tight labor market conditions that increase consumer spending power and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: When UNRATE < 3.5%, 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of cases over the last 5 years (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A high employment level (PAYEMS > 150000) as of t-1mo reflects sustained economic strength and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS > 150000, 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of cases over the last 5 years (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%) combined with declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals monetary tightening coupled with weakening economic activity, causing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: In instances where FEDFUNDS > 5.0% and INDPRO < 100, 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of cases (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In manufacturing slowdowns (INDPRO < 100), declining industrial output reduces corporate earnings growth and triggers risk-off sentiment, producing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: In manufacturing slowdowns (INDPRO < 100), 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases over the last 5 years (t-test p > 0.05).
